card.name: Linking words before cancer conditions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (mostly "with", also "of" and "or") that come right before a cancer diagnosis or history, as in "patients with a prior history of bladder cancer" or "adjuvant treatment of adult patients with CSCC".

modes.label: "with" after patients
modes.description: The word "with" after "patients" or "adult patients" and before a cancer type or cancer history.
modes.example: Adjuvant treatment of adult patients<< with>> CSCC at high risk of recurrence after

modes.label: "of" or "or" before cancer terms
modes.description: "of" or "or" joining cancer-related phrases, such as after "treatment" or between "advanced" and "metastatic".
modes.example: In patients with advanced<< or>> metastatic breast cancer, if coadministration

card.writes: No clear effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the pattern.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words like "with" just before a cancer diagnosis in a label's patient-population wording.
